purpose: Phase-7B tumour-vasculature context profiles per species + tumour model. Each names the ordinal component states (angiogenic state / vessel maturity / perfusion / oxygen supply / nutrient / permeability) describing that context's ACTIVE vascular architecture. The frozen package has NO direct tumour-vasculature dataset for this NLC, so every profile is a LABELLED prediction (general tumour-vasculature biology) or NOT_REPORTED - never experimental. Species are strictly isolated; no profile silently transfers (distinct values, not copied). Vessels MODIFY delivery/oxygen/nutrient only.

mouse_b16bl6_vascular.uncertainty: Abnormal melanoma vasculature (highly vascularized but immature/chaotic, poorly perfused, leaky/high-permeability) is inferred from general tumour biology; no direct vascular characterization for this B16BL6 tripterine-NLC context is in the frozen package. All values schematic ordinal.
mouse_b16bl6_vascular.limitations: No absolute blood flow / vessel count / pO2 / vascular diameter / perfusion rate (all NOT_REPORTED).

human_skin_vascular.uncertainty: A PREDICTIVE, exploratory human skin/tumour vasculature with its OWN distinct ordinal states - NOT copied from mouse. Not validated for human clinical response; abstract vascular architecture only.
human_skin_vascular.human_translation_warning: This vasculature is a mechanistic, exploratory prediction of the passive/active human vascular environment and is not validated for human clinical response.
human_skin_vascular.limitations: Predictive only; no human vascular measurement; all values schematic ordinal (NOT_REPORTED quantitatively).

rat_skin_vascular.uncertainty: Rat data support skin permeation only; no rat tumour vasculature dataset. No vascular architecture is generated from skin-permeation evidence alone.
rat_skin_vascular.reason: no rat tumour vasculature evidence -> NOT_REPORTED

context_rules.modifier_not_replacement: Vasculature MODIFIES oxygen / nutrient / drug accessibility / penetration opportunity; it never signals, induces apoptosis, remodels, or replaces an upstream engine.
context_rules.species_isolation: Mouse / human / rat vascular profiles are strictly isolated; no vasculature transfers silently - a cross-species use requires a CONTEXT_TRANSFER_PREDICTION label.
context_rules.not_reported_stays: Rat stays NOT_REPORTED; human is a labelled predictive-exploratory mode.
context_rules.independent_from_ecm: Vascular oxygen supply is independent from the Phase-7A passive ECM oxygen field.
